purpose: Checks eligibility of a Swift CSCF Independent Assessment Framework assessment: route (internal 2nd/3rd line vs external) against a policy-supplied permitted-routes table, claimed assessor certifications against a policy-supplied required set, a distinct-identity independence test, and assessment-date validity against the attestation deadline. Returns eligible/ineligible with the first failing predicate named.
